what: TMS320C5x on-chip ROM, read from the DSP of a live Courier
board: 20.16 MHz Courier V.Everything, ID_SDL v4.03d, supervisor 7.4.16, DSP 3.1.2
method: probe_transport --rom-dump, delivered to supervisor RAM with ATGLK2W and started by enabling timer 0's interrupt (T0CON.INT), read with RPT/TBLR from a kernel at program 0x8000 and returned through the DSP mailbox
corroboration: an earlier truncated run returned words 0x0000-0x01ea and agrees with this one on all 491, and the 56-word sample probe independently returned 0x0000-0x001f
caveats: The frame carries no controls or completion marker; what checks it is the tag sequence during collection, the declared word count and the checksum.
MP/MC was not read directly. That program 0x0000 holds a vector table and not the kernel's own first words is what shows on-chip ROM is mapped there.
